comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Sometime after the Atlantis expansion is released, this can be used to craft Pegasus Feather via Aide Quarters Production. Somewhat conveniently, this item will also be craftable through Aide Quarters Production, as well.

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemShow?id=3206

It will require Handicrafts R12 (both player AND a reserve aide at that level; remember +1 Handi skill on an Aide gives them a bonus of 5 to their Handi) to access the recipe, plus the following materials: x1 Greek Goddess Amulet and x2 "Toolbox of Daedalus", a Labyrinth dungeon item. The new upcoming Adept of Ages title may also be required.

comments.author: Cash
comments.body:
After three days of killing smaller Rhode pirate fleets, i was able to spawn a quite a few of the 'Rare' Large Rhode Pirate fleets but actually plundering this item took a lot of time and wasn't easy. I suggest having someone to spam surgery/repair support you or ALT while in battle. The fleet uses flame-shot and white smoke bombs and you need to be careful no to kill them too quickly. Alas I was finally able to plunder one of these..

The Smaller Rhode fleet drop White smoke bomb White smoke bomb 01500031 and the 'Rare' Large Rhode fleet will drop Tyrian Purple Tyrian Purple 01600356 and Seal of condemnation Seal of condemnation 01500066 along with this MA item
